releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.131:
- DEPARTMENT SUB-TAB CARDS: Sub-categories across all departments (Liquor, Wine, Cocktails, Food) now render as large, touch-friendly, vibrantly colored cards matching the Beer croquis layout.
- CLEAN SALES SCREEN: Eliminated clutter and persistent pills above products; categorized items tuck neatly into their sub-tab folders, hiding from the root screen.
- STEP-INTO & BACK BROWSING: Tapping any sub-category card opens its dedicated catalog with an immediate Back button to return to top-level cards.
- VISUAL MENU MIRROR SYNC: Options -> Edit by Mirror View allows effortless adding of new sub-tabs, full assignment of products to sub-folders, and right-click removal of unwanted sub-categories.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings across all integrity vectors.
